confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are triangulated from secondhand cost-of-living indexes, travel blogs and a French price tracker with mixed dates, so they are approximate. No direct wine price was found; wine_glass is derived from the beer anchor at roughly 2.5 times, a typical restaurant markup. Cocktail is partly supported by one guide's starting price for mid-range casual restaurants. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context, not checked against live listings or current booking pages. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure I could confirm (20 March 2026). It is likely older than the generation date and was not verified as the latest published observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Caribbean resort-town basis, placed in the Latin America region because Jamaica is not a listed option. Food anchors reflect local cookshop prices and tourist-corridor restaurant ranges reported in the sources. Accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of mid-market Caribbean resort towns with similar tourist demand.
